name: eq_bench_head2head
description: LLM responses in situations designed to test emotional intelligence. From Sam Paech's eq-bench. Sampled head2head examples for GRPO, where the LLM being post-trained must guess from the role-playing LLMs' thought processes which one ended up writing a higher scoring response along some given dimension.
reputation: Niche research dataset (Sam Paech) used for emotion/IE-style head-to-head evaluation and GRPO experiments; limited mainstream adoption.
